_comment: Shared vectors for adaptive quality: the ladder of tiers, the frame budget, the refresh-rate estimate,
and synthetic frame sequences with the tier changes the governor must make on them
(CoreQualityLadder, CoreFrameBudget, CoreQualityGovernor and the Flutter / Web seats that feed it).
Read by coui_core (every table replayed on the pure types), coui_flutter (the `cost` traces are replayed
as FrameTimings through the app's host and the tier read back off the rendered theme), coui_web (the
`interval` traces are replayed as requestAnimationFrame timestamps through the DOM-free sampler and the
tier read back off the document attribute). A change on one seat fails the others.
Every expected frame is stated by hand from the tuning constants, not computed by the code under test; each
trace says how (`derivation`).
Frames. A trace is run-length steps: {frames: n, ratio: r} is n frames of r budgets, {frames: n, pattern:
[r1, r2, ...]} cycles the ratios, and {event: hold | release | reset} sits between frames. Frames are
numbered from 1 over every frame fed, skipped and held ones included; `expect[].frame` is the frame whose
arrival made the governor report the change.
Costs and clocks. A frame of ratio r at refreshHz h has cost round(r * round(1e6 / h)) microseconds. The
clock a frame ends on advances by max(budget, cost) for the `cost` metric (a frame cannot end sooner than
the display shows it) and by the cost itself for `interval` (the cost IS the time since the last frame).
The first interval frame of a replay has a predecessor at time zero.
Tuning is the default one (CoreQualityTuning). At 60 Hz that is: skip 90 frames, warm-up 180, window 120,
settle after a hold 60, cooldown 8 s; at 120 Hz twice those frame counts, at 30 Hz half.
`hold` opens a hold and `release` releases it (CoreQualityGovernor.hold); `reset` is an app resume after a
pause (CoreQualityGovernor.reset). `rungs` are the tiers the governor steps between; `initial` skips the
warm-up.

microsFor.note: a non-positive rate is not reported

estimate.name: 60 Hz with a quarter of the frames dropped
the 59.94 Hz of an NTSC-derived panel
a page already dropping every frame is not read as a 30 Hz display
one bunched-up frame in five does not make the display faster

traces.name: a comfortable device never leaves the top
traces.derivation: warm-up P75 0.3 < 1.0 -> target 0; every runtime window P95 0.3 < 0.5 is comfortable; nothing to give up

traces.name: the warm-up settles a very heavy device on the floor in one decision
traces.derivation: frames 1-90 skipped (ratio 4 ignored); frames 91-270 are the warm-up, P75 = 2.0; target = 1 + floor((2.0-1.0)/0.5) = 3, clamped to the last rung (2); decided on frame 270

traces.name: the warm-up gives up one rung for a device just over budget
traces.derivation: P75 = 1.2; target = 1 + floor(0.2/0.5) = 1 -> noRefraction on frame 270

traces.name: a warm-up just under the start line keeps the top
traces.derivation: P75 = 0.99 < 1.0 -> target 0; the skipped frames (ratio 3) are not counted

traces.name: a quarter of the warm-up frames over the line does not decide the tier
traces.derivation: 180 frames, 45 over (25%): nearest rank ceil(.75*180)=135 -> sorted index 134; indices 0-134 are the 135 comfortable frames -> P75 = 0.4 -> target 0

traces.name: one frame more than a quarter of the warm-up over the line does
traces.derivation: warm-up frames 91-270: 2 at 3.0, then 178 cycling [.4,.4,.4,3.0] -> 44 more at 3.0 (the last two frames of the run are .4): 46 over, 134 comfortable; sorted index 134 (rank 135) is a 3.0 -> P75 = 3.0 -> target = 1 + floor(2.0/0.5) = 5, clamped to the last rung

traces.name: two over windows in a row give up one rung
traces.derivation: warm-up (frames 91-270) P75 0.5 -> stays; runtime windows are frames 271-390 and 391-510; both P95 1.3 > 1.0 -> over streak 2 on frame 510; no earlier change so the cooldown is clear

traces.name: a single over window between comfortable ones changes nothing
traces.derivation: windows: comfortable, over (streak 1), then comfortable clears it; never two in a row

traces.name: a few slow frames do not make a window over: P95 skips the worst 5%
traces.derivation: 1 slow frame in 20 = 6 of 120 per window; nearest rank ceil(.95*120)=114 -> index 113; the 6 slow frames sort to indices 114-119 -> P95 = 0.4

traces.name: one more slow frame in a window makes it over
traces.derivation: 1 in 17 -> 8 slow per 136? pattern length 17: 120 frames hold 7 slow (indices 16,33,...,118 -> 7); 7 slow sort to indices 113-119 -> P95 = 3.0 -> over; two windows -> frame 510

traces.name: the cooldown holds the next step down until eight seconds have passed
traces.derivation: first change on frame 510. Frames cost 1.3 budget = 21667 us each. Windows end on 630, 750, 870, 990 (streak 1,2,3,4); the streak is 2 at 750 but 240 frames * 21667 = 5.2 s < 8 s; at 870 it is 360 * 21667 = 7.8 s < 8 s; at 990 it is 480 * 21667 = 10.4 s >= 8 s -> second change on frame 990

traces.name: the last rung cannot be given up
traces.derivation: warm-up goes straight to the floor; over windows after that have nowhere to go

traces.name: recovery is slow: ten comfortable windows take one rung back, ten more the next
traces.derivation: floor on frame 270. Comfortable (0.2 < 0.5) windows end on 390 ... ; the 10th ends on 270 + 1200 = 1470 -> step up (cooldown long past: 1200 frames * 16667 us = 20 s). Streak resets; the 10th after is frame 2670

traces.name: a window between the lines decays recovery instead of erasing it
traces.derivation: start at the floor (no warm-up); skip frames 1-90; windows 1-9 comfortable (streak 9), window 10 at 0.8 is between 0.5 and 1.0 (streak 8), windows 11-12 comfortable (streak 10) -> step up on frame 90 + 12*120 = 1530. A reset-to-zero would need ten more windows

traces.name: without step up the tier only ever falls
traces.derivation: comfortable windows pile up but a step up is not allowed

traces.name: a rung taken back and lost again doubles the wait for the next
traces.derivation: step up on 90 + 10*120 = 1290 (probation 5). Over windows end on 1410, 1530, 1650, 1770: streak is 2 at 1530 but 240 * 21667 us = 5.2 s < 8 s, 360 * 21667 = 7.8 s at 1650, 480 * 21667 = 10.4 s at 1770 -> step down on 1770 inside probation (decremented by windows 1-3 to 2 left, still > 0) -> failed step up, wait doubles to 20 windows. Then 2400 comfortable frames = 20 windows from frame 1770: step up on 1770 + 2400 = 4170

traces.name: measurement held: frames under a hold and the second after are not judged
traces.derivation: warm-up quiet. 400 frames of 3.0 under the hold: dropped. After the release 60 settle frames (1 s at 60 Hz) dropped. Windows then end on 671+60+120-1 = frame 850 and 970 (frames 731-850, 851-970): both over -> degrade on frame 970

traces.name: the same overload without a hold degrades while it lasts
traces.derivation: control for the hold trace: windows end on 390 and 510 -> change on 510

traces.name: a reset starts the warm-up over and may raise the tier
traces.derivation: started at noRefraction; 420 comfortable frames, no step up yet (windows 2..: first window ends 210, ten needed -> none by 420). Reset after frame 420: skip 90 + warm-up 180 -> decision on frame 690, P75 0.3 -> target 0 -> full

traces.name: a reset with step up not allowed does not raise the tier
traces.derivation: the warm-up after the reset finds room but a step up is not allowed

traces.name: an initial tier skips the warm-up and judges windows after the skip
traces.derivation: skip frames 1-90; windows end on 210 and 330 -> two over -> step down on frame 330

traces.name: an initial tier the rungs have no step for starts at the one that looks the same
traces.derivation: noRefraction is not a rung here (the engine draws no bend); the greatest rung not above it is full

traces.name: the counts follow the refresh rate: a window is two seconds at 120 Hz too
traces.derivation: budget 8333 us: skip 1.5 s = 180 frames, warm-up 3 s = 360 frames; frames 181-540 at 1.3 -> P75 1.3 -> target 1 -> decided on frame 540

traces.name: at 30 Hz the same seconds are fewer frames
traces.derivation: budget 33333 us: skip 1.5 s = 45 frames, warm-up 3 s = 90 frames

traces.name: a window exactly at the budget is not over
traces.derivation: ratio 1.0 -> cost 16667 = the budget; over is strictly greater, and 1.0 is not below 0.5 either, so the windows are neither

traces.name: a window a microsecond past the budget is over
traces.derivation: ratio 1.00006 -> cost 16668 > 16667; two windows -> frame 510

traces.name: a warm-up exactly at the budget gives up one rung
traces.derivation: P75 = 16667 = 1.0 budgets: the start line is inclusive; target = 1 + floor(0 / 0.5) = 1

traces.name: a warm-up just under one and a half budgets takes one rung
traces.derivation: target = 1 + floor(0.45 / 0.5) = 1

traces.name: a warm-up at one and a half budgets takes the second rung
traces.derivation: cost 25001 = 1.50006 budgets: target = 1 + floor(0.50006 / 0.5) = 2

traces.name: comfortable is strictly under half a budget
traces.derivation: 0.51 is not under 0.5: no comfortable window ever builds, so the floor holds

traces.name: under half a budget is comfortable
traces.derivation: 0.49 < 0.5: ten comfortable windows end on 90 + 1200

traces.name: a page whose frames arrive on time is comfortable
traces.derivation: warm-up P75 1.0 < 1.5; windows P95 1.0 < 1.15 are comfortable; nothing to give up

traces.name: a third of the frames dropped moves the warm-up one rung
traces.derivation: 60 of 180 intervals are 2.0: sorted index 134 (rank 135) is a 2.0 -> P75 = 2.0; target = 1 + floor((2.0-1.5)/1.0) = 1

traces.name: a quarter of the frames dropped is not enough for the warm-up
traces.derivation: 45 of 180 intervals are 2.0: sorted index 134 is a 1.0 -> P75 1.0 -> target 0. The runtime then degrades (below)

traces.name: a quarter of the frames dropped degrades at runtime, after two windows
traces.derivation: windows of 120 intervals hold 30 twos: P95 index 113 is a 2.0 -> 2.0 > 1.5 over; two windows -> frame 510 (cooldown clear)

traces.name: six dropped frames in every window do not make a window over
traces.derivation: pattern of 20 gives 6 twos in each of the two 120-frame windows (indices 19,39,...,119 and 139,...,239): they sort to indices 114-119, and P95 (rank 114, index 113) is 1.0 -> comfortable, never over

traces.name: seven dropped frames in every window make it over
traces.derivation: pattern of 17 gives 7 twos per 120 frames: P95 index 113 is a 2.0 -> over, twice in a row -> frame 510

traces.name: an on-time page after a drop recovers after ten comfortable windows
traces.derivation: intervals of exactly one budget are < 1.15 -> comfortable; the 10th window ends on 90 + 1200

traces.name: intervals between the lines are neither over nor comfortable
traces.derivation: 1.3 is above 1.15 (not comfortable) and below 1.5 (not over): no streak builds either way

traces.name: a page between the lines keeps the top
traces.derivation: the skip takes 90 frames, then windows of 120; each has P95 1.3 budgets, above 1.15 (not comfortable) and below 1.5 (not over): nothing to degrade and nothing banked, at the top rung where a threshold set too low would act

traces.name: a warm-up exactly at the dropped-frame line takes one rung
three budgets between frames takes the second rung
